sentences.text: Iffco Tokio Gen. Ins. vs . Mohan Singh on 18 July, 2023

Author: Vivek Singh Thakur
Bench: Vivek Singh Thakur
Iffco Tokio Gen. Ins. vs. Mohan Singh .
Fao(Mva) No. 25 of 2020 18.07.2023
Present: Mr. Aman Sood, Advocate for the appellant.
Mr. Ashok K. Tyagi, Advocate for respondent No.1.
Mr. M.L. Sharma, Advocate for respondents No.2 and r to Cmp No. 7239 of 2023
This application has been filed on behalf of respondent No.1 for release of amount of compensation.
The application has been duly supported by affidavit of respondent No.1/applicant.

Learned counsel for appellant/non-applicant has opposed the release of entire amount of compensation on the ground that the amount awarded by the MACT is on higher side and there is every likelihood of reduction thereof.

It has been further submitted that in case amount is released,
it would be difficult for the Insurance Company to recover the same from claimants.

Learned counsel for the respondent No.1/applicant submits that respondent/applicant, who has been injured in the accident, is agitating his case for getting fair and just compensation but has not received the same till date.

Taking into consideration the entire facts and circumstances, at this stage, it would be appropriate to release 50% .
of the amount of compensation along with up-to-date interest in favour of respondent No.1/applicant by remitting the same in his bank account, mentioned in para 5 of application.
Photocopy of front page of his pass book has been placed on record.

The aforesaid release of amount of compensation shall be subject to final outcome of appeal and in case, excess amount is found to be received by applicant/respondent No.1, he shall be liable to repay the same with interest from the date of receipt till final repayment thereof.
